caption: #1690: a tightly drawn-up Spearmen block, 5 files at a 0.45 m pitch, is selected. Its east grip is grabbed and nudged 1.5 wu, then let go, and the block stays at 5 files. Before this fix that nudge widened it to 7, because the drag measured straight to the cursor and the grip sits more than one and a half pitches past the flank soldier. The grip is then dragged about four pitches east, and the block widens to 9 files from its fixed west edge.
